explanation: The statement is about the library's own definitions: `homogeneous2` (defined in TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology/Homogeneous.lean) and `DiscreteCoind` (defined in .../Coinduced/Discrete.lean). Searching Mathlib for `DiscreteCoind` yields no hits, so Mathlib has no declaration (nor a general coinduced-module/homogeneous-cochain analogue) stating this equivariance-in-the-first-variable formula for these objects.
